tutorial.title: How to play
tutorial.alsoBoss: This is also a boss: the tenth stage of every chapter.

find.1: One question, like "Where's the {{digit}}?", and an area marked on the board: a box, a row, a column or the whole board.
find.2: Find the one cell where the digit must go, and tap it.
find.3: A wrong tap adds 5 seconds. Two end the stage.

findDuel.1: Five spots, one after another. The bot searches with you.
findDuel.2: Whoever taps the right cell first takes the spot.
findDuel.3: A wrong tap: 3 seconds without taps, while the bot keeps searching.

fillBox.1: One box with missing cells, in a gold frame.
fillBox.2: Choose a cell in the box and type a digit. Cells outside it can't be chosen.
fillBox.3: A wrong digit adds 5 seconds. The faster you finish, the more stars.

duel.1: You and the bot on the same board, as in a game.
duel.2: First to 30 points wins, or whoever leads after 30 seconds.
duel.3: Stars by your lead at the end: 8 points for two stars, 15 for three.

spotError.1: The dark digits are the board's, and they are always right.
spotError.2: Wrong digits hide among yours. Tap them.
spotError.3: Tapping a right digit adds 5 seconds.

pointHunter.2: A cell in an empty area is worth more points.
pointHunter.3: Stars by how close you get to the board's best.

chain.1: At any moment only one cell on the board can be solved.
chain.2: Fill it, and it opens the next one.
chain.3: A digit in a cell that can't be known yet costs 5 seconds, and isn't placed.

boss.1: The tenth stage of every chapter is a boss: one fight against a bot, harder than the stages before it.
boss.2: Before it starts you see what is harder. Usually: the bot is faster.
boss.3: Once you have played the boss and have 20 stars in the chapter, the next chapter opens.

fillRow.1: One row with missing cells, in a gold frame.
fillRow.2: Choose a cell in the row and type a digit. Cells outside it can't be chosen.
fillRow.3: A wrong digit adds 5 seconds. The faster you finish, the more stars.

fillCol.1: One column with missing cells, in a gold frame.
fillCol.2: Choose a cell in the column and type a digit. Cells outside it can't be chosen.
fillCol.3: A wrong digit adds 5 seconds. The faster you finish, the more stars.

puzzle.1: Nine full boxes, in the wrong order.
puzzle.2: Drag a box onto another and they swap. A box with a lock is fixed. A swap that puts neither box in its place adds 5 seconds.
puzzle.3: When every row and column is right, the stage ends. The faster you finish, the more stars.
